snippet.title: 🎮 Bingo Roulette – Casual Strategy Bingo Game
snippet.description:
Bingo Roulette is a casual strategy bingo game where you select slots on a bingo board to earn points and complete bingos to gain bonus scores.

Bingo Roulette is coming to Steam on January 30
